nora-w: Hey all — quick onboarding questions. I enrolled in the 401(k) (Roth) during setup but the vendor portal still shows "pending enrollment". Will contributions start on my next paycheck or is there usually a lag? Also, I started Feb 10is PTO/holidays prorated that first month?
people-ops: Welcome Nora! 401(k) enrollments are submitted to the vendor nightly. Usually contributions begin on the first payroll after the vendor confirms enrollment. If the status stays pending for more than 3 business days DM us and we'll escalate. Regarding holidays: company-observed holidays are not prorated if you're active on the holiday date you get the day. PTO accrual for your first month is prorated.
sam-payroll: Quick operational detail: the vendor confirmation window closes 2 business days before a payrun. If confirmation arrives after that window your first deferral will land on the following payrun. When it posts you'll see a stub line like `401K_EMP -2.5%` or similar.
nora-w: Ok thanks. One more: I filed relocation reimbursements (movers + temporary housing). Should those be submitted as expense reports or will Finance handle a lump sum taxable payment? The onboarding packet mentioned both.
benefits-bot: Relocation reimbursements default to a taxable relocation allowance processed by Finance unless you submitted a Qualified Moving Expense document and meet the IRS exceptions. If treated as taxable you'll see a paystub line such as `RELOC_TAX -$3200` and normal payroll taxes will apply. If Finance needs additional receipts they'll reach out to the payroll contact.
nana-hr: Small note on HSA/benefits: employer HSA contributions prorate based on active days in the month if you enroll mid-month. If you added dependents, upload proof (birth/marriage) to MyBenefits within 30 days to avoid coverage delays.
nora-w: Got it. Last tiny thing: where's the company holiday calendar? I want to add it to my personal calendar.
people-ops: There's a shared Google Calendar named "Redwood Company Holidays" — you should have access by default. If not, ping us and we'll add you. We'll also attach the holiday list to your onboarding doc in Casebook.
sam-payroll: Payrun note: next scheduled run is 2026-04-15. If you expect the relocation allowance on that run and it doesn't appear by 2026-04-20, file a payroll ticket and reference this thread's timestamp.
nora-w: Amazing, appreciate the help everyone! :raised_hands:
